notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.3.0
notes.content: [h3][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Keyboard Shortcuts Menu[/b]: Added a new section in Settings that lists all available keyboard shortcut options.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toggle Kind Mode Anytime[/b]: Players can now turn Kind Mode on or off at any point via the smiley face icon next to their character's name in the top-left corner. [i]Note: This option is unavailable if the character has Permadeath Mode enabled, as the two modes are incompatible.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Creature Morality Indicators[/b]: Creatures now display a red/gray/green color-coded morality alignment during initial encounters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speed Status Indicator[/b]: Your character's speed stat now shows if you’re currently affected by a temporary slow or speed boost by saying (Slowed) or (Boosted) by your current speed.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]Kind Mode Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]XP Boost[/b]: +30% XP gain while Kind Mode is active.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased Legendary Encounters[/b]: Encounter chance for legendary creatures raised from 3% to 5%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Passive Regen[/b]: Recover 2% HP and Mana per turn while traveling or waiting.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]Combat & Encounters Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]XP for Fleeing Creatures[/b]: Players now gain partial XP when creatures flee mid-combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enemy Flee Chance Reduced[/b]: Slightly lowered global enemy flee success rates by 10%. [i](Level and speed differentials still apply to this chance as before.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Area Level Adjustments[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Merchant Port[/b]: Level range reduced from 1-15 to 1-10[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rocky Path[/b]: Level range reduced from 1-15 to 1-10[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Encounter Damage Scaling[/b]: Damage from encounters (for example, snake bites, carnivorous plants, or getting sick in the rain) now scale based on your level difference, instead of a flat damage amount.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]New Items & Equipment[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Consumables[/b]: A handful of new consumable items have been added to the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Gear[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]15+ new weapons and ammo types added, including enchanted gear.[/p][/*][*][p]A new shield.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Some weapons now have special effects, similar to spells, including: Burning, Poisoning, Paralysis, Health Absorption, and more![/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Old Gear Rebalanced[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Many previously existing weapons received damage increases and higher gold value for better balance against equivalent-tier spells.[/p][/*][*][p]Some old weapons also gained new types and/or special effects.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Encounter Item Pool Expansion[/b]: More variety has been added to loot found during various encounters.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]New Spells[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]5 New Spells Added[/b] (one for each magic type)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New World Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]11 New Encounters[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]3 New Quests[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issues with the Health/Mana full chime and status box flashing triggering at incorrect times.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to certain achievements being unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]What's Next[/b][/h3][p align="start"]It's the last Friday in August, so this is the final [i]weekly[/i] content update, I hope you all have enjoyed them! I don't have an exact date for the next content and feature update yet, but I know it will be coming sometime before the end of September.[/p][p align="start"]If you've been enjoying your adventure [b]please consider[/b] [b]leaving a review[/b], it would really help![/p]

notes.title: Mythscroll v1.0.0 Launches August 11 - Patch Notes & Info
notes.content:
[p]Here’s everything new, updated, and fixed in the upcoming full launch of [i]Mythscroll[/i]! The full game adds new systems, balances progression, introduces new content and achievements, and improves overall player experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay & Mechanics[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Evade Ambushes with Stealth[/b]
You now have a chance to evade surprise attacks and ambushes from aggressive creatures based on your [b]Stealth[/b] stat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Armor Speed Rework[/b]
Rebalanced how armor affects speed:[/p][list][*][p]Light and heavy armor skills now have a greater impact.[/p][/*][*][p]Wearing heavy armor without proper skill is more punishing; mastering armor gives more noticeable benefits.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Enchanted Weapon System[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now damage fully physically immune creatures (e.g., ghosts, wraiths, will-o-wisps) using enchanted weapons or ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Enchanted arrows also work in regular bows.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Creature Morality Behavior[/b][/p][list][*][p]Creatures who are closer to your morality are more agreeable and easier to talk to and persuade.[/p][/*][*][p]Some creatures may now flee before or during combat, especially when threatened or confronted by evil-aligned players.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Creature Interaction Options[/b][/p][list][*][p]New option: [b]Ask for directions[/b] during creature encounters.[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed "Threaten creature" to [b]"Rob creature"[/b], and made it a standalone option (no need to talk the creature first).[/p][/*][*][p]Creatures can now also [b]attempt to rob you[/b] of gold or items.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Merchant & Theft Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Merchant inventories now scale with [b]area level[/b], no more buying top-tier gear in starter areas.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Robbing merchants[/b] or trying to [b]learn a language for free[/b] is now more difficult.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Resting Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resting is now [b]30% more likely[/b] to succeed in all areas.[/p][/*][*][p]You can [b]always rest safely[/b] in towns and designated safe zones.[/p][/*][*][p]Boost your [b]Stealth[/b] stat to rest successfully even more often in the wild.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]World, Encounters & Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Creatures[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added: [b]Basilisk[/b], [b]Cursed Armor[/b], [b]Valkyrie[/b], and [b]Carnivorous Plant, [/b]bringing the total number of unique, non-faction creatures to 85.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Encounters[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]60+ new branching encounters, [/b]bringing the total number of random encounters to 100+[/p][/*][*][p]More coming: [b]50+ additional encounters[/b] arriving in updates over the next few weeks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Jobs & Quests[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]20+ new jobs and quests.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]More coming: [b]10+ more quests[/b] on the way in the next few weeks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fishing System[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now [b]go fishing[/b] if:[/p][list][*][p]You have a [b]fishing pole. [/b]Hint:[spoiler]A fishing pole can be acquired by completing a quest found along the rocky path.[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]You're near a body of water (river, lake, ocean coastline) or find a pond in a random encounter.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Fast Travel System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Unlocked once you've [b]completed the full world map.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Spells & Equipment[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Spells Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Effects include: [b]Confuse, Slow, Weaken, Burn, Paralyze, Unconscious, Drain Health, Heal Self[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Spellbook now supports [b]hover tooltips[/b]: View each spell’s attack type, damage, speed, mana cost, and effects.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Equipment Panel Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Click items in your [b]equipment panel[/b] to automatically open your [b]inventory to that item[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Weapon Naming Fix[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sickles renamed to [b]Scythes[/b], now properly reflected as [b]two-handed weapons[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]More Gear & Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]A variety of [b]new gear[/b] and [b]items[/b] have been added throughout the world.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Achievements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Achievements Now Live![/b][/p][list][*][p][b]120 in-game achievements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]100 Steam achievements[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Track your progress across combat, exploration, questing, crafting, and more.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Misc Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Updated Tutorial[/b][/p][list][*][p]Refreshed and expanded for better onboarding.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Code Refactoring[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cleaned up and optimized some complex internal systems.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addressed various reported bugs and inconsistencies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]More Upcoming Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Known bugs[/b] - These minor bugs are not yet fixed, but have fixes planned over the next couple weeks:[/p][list][*][p]Visual / text glitches where the tops or bottoms of some words or numbers are slightly cut off, but still legible.[/p][/*][*][p]Rare instances where items are not referenced grammatically correctly, for example misuses a vs an.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Additional content[/b] - More encounters and quests are planned to be added over the next few weeks.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.3.1
notes.content: [h3][b]Major New Feature: The Compendium[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The [b]Compendium[/b] has been made available to provide information on key game elements:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]Attributes[/b] and [b]Skills[/b] tabs are pre-filled with information about the attributes and skills in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Locations[/b], [b]Creatures[/b], and [b]Factions[/b] tabs will populate automatically as your character discovers them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Note for existing saves[/b]: Locations you've already discovered will appear in the compendium upon loading your save file after updating the game, but creatures will not.[b] [/b]That data wasn't tracked prior to this update, so all players will start with an empty creature log.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]World & Gameplay Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Cities are now safe zones.[/b] Creatures in cities now have a minimum morality set to 'neutral', ensuring players won’t be attacked in safe areas, unless your character has very low morality, in which case 'righteous' morality creatures (e.g. knights, guards, angels) will still target you.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Quality of Life & Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Keyboard Shortcut[/b]: Press [b]F1[/b] to toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode. This can be used to resolve rare cases where the game launches to a black screen in fullscreen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level-Up Screen Fixes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where base stats were incorrectly displayed on the level-up screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]“Real-Time Stats” toggle[/b] on the level-up screen to allow you to switch between viewing your base stats and your current stats (with accessory and temporary bonuses applied).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Now Available on Linux![/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Mythscroll now supports Linux! [/b]A Linux build is available alongside Windows. If you’re playing on Linux, I’d love to hear your feedback and reports on performance or issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h3][p]This will likely be the [b]final update for the demo[/b], as I shift focus toward completing the full version of [i]Mythscroll[/i] for release. Please continue to share your feedback and bug reports; it is still very helpful. Thank you so much to everyone who’s played, shared feedback, and helped shape the game so far![/p][p]If you haven’t already, don’t forget to [url="https://discord.com/invite/cyAsWKnqUS"]join the Discord[/url] to follow development and share your thoughts. I will soon be launching another poll to allow players to vote on the next creature added to the game![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.2.3
notes.content: [h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b] are now enabled for the demo! Your progress will sync across devices automatically.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]World & Encounter Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Creatures now display a [b]power descriptor[/b] upon initial encounter based on level difference:[/p][list][*][p]+5 levels: "a strong (creature)"[/p][/*][*][p]+10 levels: "a powerful (creature)"[/p][/*][*][p]+20 levels: "a very powerful (creature)"[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Certain areas can no longer be discovered via signposts; you’ll need to find them the old-fashioned way.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay & UX Enhancements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]If you finish a quest while in a city, you’ll no longer need to travel again to access city options; they now appear immediately after the quest ends.[/p][/*][*][p][b]During encounters, if a stat check is required for a choice, the relevant stat is now highlighted in your attributes or skills panel when hovering over that option button.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Inventory & Item Info Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Armor and clothing now display additional information in your inventory:[/p][list][*][p]Armor Type (e.g. Type: Heavy Armor, Type: Clothing)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Weapons now display additional information in your inventory:[/p][list][*][p]Weapon Style (e.g. Weapon Style: One Handed)[/p][/*][*][p]Damage Type(s) (e.g. Damage Type: Bash, Damage Types: Stab, Slash)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Jewelry that grants traits now displays the stat modifiers included with those traits.[/p][list][*][p]Example: +Bookworm Trait (+1 Int, -1 Str)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]These changes will only impact new items added to the inventory, this update will not affect items already in your character's inventory[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where accepting any job on a job board always assigned the first job on the board, regardless of which one was selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some inventory items were unclickable due to UI overlap with the “Disabled Compendium” button.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched an exploit where players could gain infinite XP by repeatedly bartering at city shops. You now must leave and re-enter the shop to attempt bartering again, making the exploit much slower and less viable.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.2.2​​
notes.content: [p]This small patch includes a couple of bug fixes and some balance adjustments based on player feedback. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Level-Up Improvement[/b]: Your character's health and mana now fully refill when you level up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Attribute Health/Mana Scaling Adjustments[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Intelligence and Constitution now begin to increase your max mana and health earlier than before, starting at attribute levels 5 instead of 6.​[/p][/*][*][p]The impact of these attributes on max health and mana has increased 20%.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]UI & Visual Updates[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Ocean Visibility[/b]: Increased the size of wave lines in ocean to make it clearer which areas are water.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Default Screen Mode Change[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]The default screen mode has been changed from fullscreen to windowed. This is a temporary workaround for a rare issue some players are experiencing where the game launches to a black screen in fullscreen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]This change will affect all new and returning players[/b] when first launching the game after the update, but you can simply switch back to fullscreen mode in Settings once, and it will remember your preference.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Health/Mana Display Bug[/b]: Fixed an issue where increases to max health or mana from leveling Intelligence or Constitution didn’t display correctly until restarting the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Language Merchant Fix[/b]: Resolved a bug where convincing or threatening the language merchant would show “\[insert language here]” instead of the actual language and fail to teach it.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - v0.2.1
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603763/fa363b019ad83cfb02f00b71d97c7bb2bd9af103.png"][/img]This demo update brings a mix of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, mechanical reworks, and new content! Here's everything that's new or changed:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Improvements[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Refined Combat Mechanics[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Armor and armor skills are now more effective at reducing damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced enemy health and attack values.[/p][/*][*][p]Character Speed, Creature Speed, and Weapon Speed now play a greater role in combat turn order, with possible missed attacks or follow up attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Signature weapon bonus reduced from +20% to +10% damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Constitution and Intelligence now restore health or mana when leveling up. (e.g. 80/100 HP → +20 max → now 100/120 HP).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Luck Stat Rework: [/b]Luck has a chance to give you a second chance on failed checks.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Health & Mana Bars[/b]: Now show numerical values (e.g. 50 / 100).[/p][p][/p][p][b]Enemy HUD[/b]: Added a toggleable setting to show enemy level and health bars. This is enabled by default.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Windowed / Fullscreen Toggle[/b]: You can now switch between windowed and fullscreen mode from the settings menu.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Exploration & World Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]Map Enhancements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Added a compass and distance scale (in kilometers).[/p][/*][*][p]The river line on the map now starts hidden and becomes visible when discovered (like other locations).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Travel & Waiting Tweaks[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Increased success chance when resting by +10%, even on failed Stealth and Luck checks.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased chances of nothing happening when waiting or traveling by +5%.[/p][/*][*][p]Greatly reduced odds of the language merchant running off without teaching the language.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Tutorials & Onboarding[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Character Creator Tutorial[/b]: Brief guide added to walk players through character creation.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Game Tutorial[/b]: Added a short tutorial that runs on starting a new game or loading a save file for the first time after updating. Returning players can choose to skip it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Stat-Boosting Meals[/b][/h3][p]Some food and drinks purchased at taverns  and inns now grant temporary stat bonuses:[/p][list][*][p]Beer, cider, or wine: +1 Charisma for 10 minutes[/p][/*][*][p]Beef stew: +1 Strength for 10 minutes[/p][/*][*][p]And more![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Stat Check Rebalancing[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Stat checks now cap at 2% (minimum) and 99% (maximum)[b]; [/b]there are no longer guaranteed successes or failures based purely on stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased stat check success threshold by 5%[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where undiscovered nearby locations were incorrectly marked as discovered when loading a save.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where fullscreen mode wouldn’t activate properly on startup.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where damage from divine curses (e.g., from failing a Religion check or underpaying at shrines) would reduce the player to 0 HP but not kill them.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Morality System Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reduced negative morality penalties for certain actions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added several [b]new encounters and quests[/b] across the world, including a few jobs on the job board at the tavern in Capital City. Keep exploring, you might just stumble into something new![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks everyone, hope you enjoy the update! Please report any issues to the #bug-reports channel in the [url="https://discord.com/invite/cyAsWKnqUS"]Discord[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Demo -> Full Game Road Map
notes.content:
Hey everyone! With Mythscroll's demo now live, I'm hard at work polishing, expanding, and preparing for the full release on August 12th. Here's what you can expect in the coming months:


[h1]🔧 June Demo Update - Polish, Depth, and More Content[/h1]

I'm planning a demo update in June to add more mechanical depth and player guidance, while giving you a better feel for the full game's systems. No exact date just yet, but here’s what’s on the way:

[h3]🍲 Stat-Boosting Meals[/h3]
The food sold at inns and taverns will temporarily boost/alter your stats.

[h3]⚔️ Refined Combat Mechanics[/h3]
Speed and weapon speed will have a more noticeable impact. Expect more missed attacks from slower enemies, and maybe even a chance to strike twice if you're fast enough!

[h3]📜 Tutorial[/h3]
A light tutorial is coming to ease new players in and explain core mechanics without getting in the way of exploration.

[h3]🧭 More Encounters[/h3]
I'm adding additional environmental and creature encounters to make exploration more dynamic and surprising.

[h3]💼 Quests & Job Board Tasks[/h3]
The demo will include a few early quests and job board jobs to introduce task-based progression.



[h1]🌟 Full Game - Launching August 12, 2025[/h1]

The full version of Mythscroll is set to release on August 12th and will massively expand the world, systems, and possibilities. Here's a peek at what's coming:

[h3]🐉 New Creatures[/h3]
A couple of new monster types will join the pool. Consider joining the [url=https://discord.com/invite/cyAsWKnqUS]Discord[/url] for the opportunity to participate in polls to decide what creatures get added.

[h3]🌲 100+ New Encounters[/h3]
Diverse and region-specific events will make every journey feel unique, with expanded use of skills and branching outcomes.

[h3]📜 40+ Quests and Jobs[/h3]
From narrative-rich quests to quick job board contracts, you'll have no shortage of tasks to take on.

[h3]🔮 New Spells[/h3]
Healing spells and unique utility or support abilities will add variety to your magic options beyond just damage-dealing.

[h3]🎧 Sound Polish[/h3]
Additional sound effects will bring the world and combat to life more vividly.

[h3]⚖️ Expanded Creature Behavior[/h3]
Creatures will respond more intelligently to your morality. Some may flee if you're too powerful, or if you've earned a ruthless reputation.

[h3]🏆 Achievements[/h3]
In-game achievements to track your progress and reward exploration, experimentation, and mastery.

[h3]📖 In-Game Compendium[/h3]
A growing in-game reference filled with useful information about the world, creatures, and regions of Mythscroll. The compendium expands as you explore and encounter new places, people, and monsters.

[h3]🗺️ Fast Travel[/h3]
Once you've fully explored the world, fast travel will become available to make backtracking easier.
